scenes.narration_en: Suspicion first fell on Phan Duc Lam, the victim's business partner, locked in a dispute over a debt of more than two billion dong. That same afternoon, Lam had been near the scene. And he had threatened Vu before.

Then came the coroner's first finding: Vu had died around 10:15 p.m., more than an hour before Ha's call. No one could explain that gap. And beneath a ransacked filing cabinet, investigators picked up an engraved metal lighter.
But the red mud at the scene did not match Lam's route, and a traffic camera placed him somewhere else at 10:15 p.m.
